mapper.sql: id, eval_type, case_id, `input`, expected, category, `source`, `enabled`, origin_ref, created_at_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_eval_case (eval_type, case_id, `input`, expected, category, `source`, `enabled`, origin_ref, created_at_ms) VALUES (#{evalType}, #{caseId}, #{input}, #{expected}, #{category}, #{source}, #{enabled}, #{originRef}, #{createdAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `input` = VALUES(`input`), expected = VALUES(expected), category = VALUES(category), `source` = VALUES(`source`), `enabled` = VALUES(`enabled`), origin_ref = VALUES(origin_ref)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cw_eval_case WHERE eval_type = #{evalType} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cw_eval_case WHERE eval_type = #{evalType} AND case_id = #{caseId}
